title: A Novel Triple Luciferase Reporter Assay  Permits Measurement of  Cypridina Luciferase, Green-Emitting Renilla Luciferase and Red-Emitting Firefly Luciferase in the Same sample
protocol: Adjust the cell concentration and plate HEK-293 cells one day before the transfection experiment.
Culture cells overnight in a 60-mm culture dish with 3 ml of medium to achieve approximately 60-80% confluency at the time of transfection.
Change to fresh medium prior to transfection, using a volume of 4 ml per dish.
Form transfection complexes for the experiment.
To a small sterile tube, pipette 0.6 ml of serum-free high glucose DMEM.
Add 1 μg each of pUBC-RedFluc, pCMV-GrRenLuc, and pCMV-GLuc to the tube.
Mix well by flicking the tube 12 times.
Pipette 6 µl of Targefect F-2 transfection reagent into the tube.
Mix well again by flicking the tube 122 times.
Incubate the transfection reagent:DNA complex for 25 min at 37°C.
Add 0.6 ml of the transfection complex drop-wise to the cells through the medium, ensuring even distribution over the entire cell area.
Incubate the cells for 36-48 h.
Harvest the cells.
Aspirate supernatant from transfected cells.
Wash cells once with buffer.
Add 100 μl of cell lysis buffer per well in a 48-well dish.
Shake at 400 rpm for 15-20 minutes to lyse cells.
Pipette out 20 μl of cell lysate into 96-well dishes.
Assay cell lysates for Cypridina Luciferase according to the VLAR-1 protocol.
Add 40 μl of VLAR buffer followed by 20 μl of Vargulin substrate diluted from 100X with dilution buffer.
Alternatively, premix 40 μl of VLAR-1 buffer with 20 μl of diluted Cypridina luciferin and add 60 μl to each sample within 20 minutes of mixing.
Wait for 20-25 minutes after adding the mixture.
Assay for Firefly Luciferase by adding 50 μl of FLAR reagent.
Thaw FLAR-1 reagent as needed before use.
Assay for Renilla Luciferase by adding 60 μl of diluted Renilla luciferase assay reagent prepared from 100X substrate and RLAR plus Stop buffer.
Mix 10 μl of cell lysate into wells of a 96-well plate.
Prepare working TLAR reagent by mixing 5 ml of TLAR-1 single buffer with 50 μl of 100X coelenterazine and 20 μl of 100X Cypridina Luciferin (Vargulin).
Add 50 μl of the working TLAR-1, format-2 reagent to each well.
Mix well and read immediately to measure luciferase activity.
